profile.headline: Account Executive at Dell Technologies
profile.summary: I'm a software developer who enjoys testing and organizing code, and this role has shown me how much effort goes into maintaining a system and how much care and attention to detail it demands, both in my own work and with colleagues. Before becoming a developer, I helped two companies build their businesses from the ground up, which taught me how far organization and communication can go in both my personal and professional life. Now in the workforce, I want to find a company that values those same qualities in its employees.

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description:
Consulted clients on tailored technology solutions across client, enterprise, and mobility portfolios, translating technical specifications into business value

Managed full sales cycle from prospecting to onboarding, coordinating with cross-functional technical specialists and channel partners

Leveraged CRM to track pipeline metrics, analyze funnel data, and optimize outreach strategy

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Intensive full-time, six months software development bootcamp focusing on Python/Django development fundamentals and problem-solving. The final three months of the program were executed in a simulated company environment with SCRUM methodology.

- Daily hands-on application of OOP fundamentals through group and individual projects
- Created single-page applications in JavaScript, as well as in the React framework
- Project management/tracking with GitHub project boards and issue tracking
- Source code/version control with Git/GitHub
- Solution Design: white-boarding and wireframes
- Leveraged Django for creating and editing server-generated web applications
- Created RESTful API’s with Django REST framework
- Retrieved and stored database information with SQLite 
- Practiced testing with Python’s unit test framework

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description:
- Optimized business strategies aimed at maximizing efficiency 
- Facilitated communication between various business owners and between different languages to ensure customer satisfaction
- Ensured projects followed a specific timeline with proper communication; ensuring all team members are aligned with project goals and responsibilities
positions.insights: Project Management, Problem Solving and +2 skills

positions.title: Chief Operating Officer
positions.description:
-- Oversaw and managed multiple projects
-- Created strategies to optimize workflow with an emphasis on quality assurance
--Implemented tactics to increase customer satisfaction and business growth
positions.insights: Project Management, Quality Assurance and +3 skills
